output.summary: Annual herb native to tropical South America, Central America and the Caribbean. It has a light-green upright stem with many branches from the base. Its leaves are eaten boiled as greens or vegetables, while its nutty seeds are eaten as snacks, used in biscuits or boiled into porridge.
